name: gantry
description: Gantry: a gated plan -> build -> review pipeline for Claude Code, plus anti-drift audits. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: gantry
plugins.description: An interactive design author plus four disciplined subagents (design-reviewer, phase-planner, implementer, phase-reviewer), driven in order by one orchestrator skill with both review gates, that turn a feature idea into reviewed, phased implementation that advances one gated step at a time. Includes a currentness audit and a runtime verification queue that keep docs honest. Reads each project's own conventions; works in any stack.
